item.title: MACH2X for Shima Seiki Shaping Machine Users
item.description: These are (informal) notes about the Shima Seiki MACH2X knitting machine.

item.title: Comb
item.description: The comb force is specified in kg. The comb force is scaled to the width of the knitted fabric.

item.title: About
item.description: PZ: These are notes based on personal experience with a Shima Seiki MACH2XS153-15L and MACH2X M173X15L, and passing experience with shaping machines (SVR123SP, SES122S, SCG122SN), a Mini machine (SWG091N2), and a Kniterate.

item.title: X-Bed
item.description: “X-bed” refers to a four needle bed flat knitting machine configuration. ”V-bed” refers to a two needle bed configuration.

item.title: Comparison Between MACH2X and Other Shima Seiki Machines
item.description: Note that all these claims are based on my fairly limited experience with Shima Seiki knitting machines.
